subject: CometHealth - CAIQ mapping & evidence request
messages:
From: Emma Rogers <emma.rogers@comethealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: CometHealth Procurement <procurement@comethealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: CAIQ mapping and evidence request for vendor review

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time to talk earlier. CometHealth’s InfoSec team is running a CAIQ-based assessment as part of our vendor onboarding. We need two things from Redwood: (1) your completed CAIQ answer matrix mapped to our control set, and (2) a small evidence bundle for a subset of controls we plan to sample.

Priority controls for our sample this cycle are: identity and access management, encryption-in-transit/key management, runtime isolation, and logging/retention (we'll refer to them as IAM-01, CRY-04, RUM-02, LOG-03 in our tracker). Please confirm which artifacts you can provide by Oct 25. Example evidence we expect: sanitized network diagram, architecture narrative, key rotation policy, sample audit logs (redacted), and a signed attestation for scoped isolation assumptions.

If helpful, share a Drive folder link or a hubspot/deal id where we can track uploads. Also, we'll need a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign acknowledgement for any sensitive artifacts that require a DPA addendum before sharing.

Can you confirm owners and an internal timeline? CometHealth procurement will be looped for contractual items once we have the artifact list.

Thanks,
Emma Rogers
Senior Security Program Manager
CometHealth

--
Attachment: example_request_template.pdf (text stub)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Emma Rogers <emma.rogers@comethealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping and evidence request for vendor review

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the priorities. We're set to support CometHealth on this. I've looped Kimberly (controls/evidence lead) and Marissa (compliance ops) to own the artifacts and upload cadence. High-level plan below: 

- CAIQ answer matrix: we'll provide a populated CAIQ sheet with control-level notes and references (owner + artifact pointer).
- Evidence bundle: sanitized network diagram, sanitized infra narrative, key rotation policy extract, sample (redacted) audit logs, and a short attestation for runtime isolation scope.
- Delivery: we'll stage artifacts in a shared Drive folder and provide a CAIQ matrix (xlsx) with links. For any sensitive logs we'll provide a presigned S3 sample and a small redaction note.

Preliminary owner assignments: Kimberly will coordinate the artifacts and Marissa will run the evidence staging/upload. I can own the mutual action plan and contractual handoff to procurement.

A couple quick clarifications:
1) Please confirm whether CometHealth requires SOC 2 test window dates in the package or just a SOC 2 report summary.
2) If you need evidence under NDA/DPA terms before we share logs, indicate that and we'll pull the DocuSign acknowledgement.

Attaching our initial sanitized network diagram and the CAIQ answer matrix prefill. If those look good, Kimberly will follow up with a more granular upload schedule.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood_network_diagram.pdf (sanitized), caiq_answer_matrix.xlsx (draft)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Emma Rogers <emma.rogers@comethealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping and evidence request for vendor review

Emma — quick operational note from the evidence team. Thanks for identifying the priority controls — that helps narrow the initial package. Proposed sprint/timeline (all times PT):

- Oct 13: internal artifact pull + redaction pass (owners: infra, security eng)
- Oct 15: deliver CAIQ answer matrix v1 (links to artifacts)
- Oct 18: deliver sanitized network diagram + infra narrative + key rotation policy extract
- Oct 21: deliver sample audit logs via presigned S3 link (sample window + redaction summary)
- Oct 22: DocuSign attestation / mutual action plan for sensitive artifacts (if required)

Artifact owners (contacts inside Redwood):
- Network diagram & infra narrative: Marcus Lin (engineering) — I'll coordinate
- Key rotation policy extract: Priya Natarajan (security) — Marissa will pull the snippet
- Sample logs (redaction): DevOps logs team — we will strip PII and provide a single-day sample window

Notes / constraints:
- Logs will be shared as a presigned S3 link; we will not upload raw logs to external systems.
- Any request for long-term raw log access will need an approved DPA addendum and a signed DocuSign before we can proceed.

Drive folder (staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-ExampleDriveLink
DocuSign (draft MA plan): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embeddedSigning/example-link

I'll start the artifact pull tomorrow and report progress in this thread.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Control & Evidence Management
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: s3-presigned-sample.txt (stub with presigned URL placeholder)

From: Emma Rogers <emma.rogers@comethealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: CometHealth Procurement <procurement@comethealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping and evidence request for vendor review

Kimberly / Laura — this looks great and the timeline is workable. A couple of items from our side:

- We do want the SOC 2 report summary included in the package (not full test windows). If you can include the latest report date that will suffice for now.
- For the mutual action plan, CometHealth prefers a one-page plan that highlights owners, acceptance criteria, and target delivery dates. If you can draft that and put it in the Drive folder, procurement will be able to attach contract notes and route the DocuSign.

We appreciate the presigned-s3 approach for logs. Once we have the CAIQ matrix and initial artifacts, our security reviewer will choose a small control sample for deeper review. If anything changes on our side I'll update this thread.

Thanks again — Emma
Senior Security Program Manager
CometHealth
